question: In Chapter 487, Brook picked up a skeleton with a polka-dot shirt, which is the guy who asked to be given sword lessons in life. But in Chapter 488, you can see him alive as Brook is saying, "Shall we sing?" They supposedly died as they sang, so he must have gotten stabbed with the sword later... when was that? And who did it?
answer: Very close eye you've got. I got a couple letters about this, so allow me to introduce you! These are the identical twin Mizuta brothers. Left: Elder Brother: Mizuta Madaisuki ("I died from a stab to the head!!")Right: Younger Brother: Mizuta Mawaritosuki ("I died while singing")
name: Kopin
